name: Remote save
description: Syncs or backs up the vault with storage you own: an S3-compatible bucket (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, MinIO) or a WebDAV folder (Nextcloud and friends). Two-way, push only or pull only, on a schedule or by hand, optionally encrypted. It talks only to the addresses you add; their keys stay on the machine you enter them on.
author: Vaultite
forAgents: To back up or sync the vault with the user's own storage now: `remote-save.sync`; how the last sync went: `remote-save.status`.

remote-save.description: each remote's last sync and how it went, with sync now
remote-save.live: the syncs' results, kept on the machine that runs them

remote.description: only this remote, by its name or id
